url.description: URL of the endpoint of the storage. Use `http://` or `https://` and include the port when it is not the default one.

region.description: Region to use when connecting to the endpoint. Usually not needed, as the region is normally detected.

name.description: Name of the Secret. Expanded to `fullname-name` unless `expandObjectName` is false.

key.description: Key in the Secret that holds the CA certificate.

expandObjectName.description: Prefix the Secret name with the chart fullname.

customCASecretRef.description: Reference to a Secret that holds a custom CA, used when connecting to the endpoint in `url` over HTTPS.

customCA.description: Custom CA certificate (PEM) to use when connecting to the endpoint in `url` over HTTPS.

path.description: Path within the bucket to use, overriding the default path.

description: Credentials for a backup target, keyed by name. Used by objects that back up to or restore from S3 compatible storage.
